connector.name: PingZen Uptime Monitoring
connector.registryDescription: Uptime monitoring with 127 tools across 23 protocols. Tag filtering + Code Mode.
connector.summary: Hosted at pingzen.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image pingzen-mcp:0.9.3. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.pingzen, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key (pz_...) or JWT token — or use OAuth 2.0 (auto-handled by MCP clients)

env.name: MCP_API_TOKEN
env.description: API key (pz_...) or JWT token from PingZen (omit for test mode)
